biology.chemotaxis: cells follow chemical concentration gradients. higher concentration = closer to target.
biology.example: white blood cells follow cytokine gradient to infection site. THEY SMELL THE WOUND.
biology.axon_guidance: growing neurons follow guidance molecules (netrins, semaphorins) to find their target.
biology.ant_trails: ants lay pheromone trails. more ants = stronger trail = better route. SELF-REINFORCING.

DNS.what: Domain Name System — name → IP address
DNS.self_driving: automatic — browsers do it without thinking

beacon_routing.what: bounty board emits signals. enzymes follow signals to bounties.
beacon_routing.analogy: CHEMOTAXIS — enzyme smells the bounty and drives toward it
beacon_routing.self_driving: autonomous — enzymes self-dispatch to matching signals

ant_trail_routing.what: ant-trails.html already built! visitor paths reinforce popular routes.
ant_trail_routing.analogy: ANT COLONY OPTIMIZATION — the more traffic, the stronger the path
ant_trail_routing.self_driving: emergent — no central planner, paths form from usage

gradient_descent.what: always move toward higher reward / lower cost
gradient_descent.analogy: GRADIENT DESCENT — the fundamental algorithm of learning AND routing
gradient_descent.self_driving: mathematical — follow the slope downhill to the minimum

self_driving.title: SELF-DRIVING = autonomic nervous system + emergent routing

L1_reflexes.name: REFLEXES (fastest, no thinking)
L1_reflexes.biology: spinal reflex — hand on hot stove → pull away. no brain involved.
L1_reflexes.gaia: fail2ban (block attacker instantly), caddy auto-TLS (renew cert), health checks

L2_autonomic.name: AUTONOMIC (fast, unconscious)
L2_autonomic.biology: heart rate, breathing, digestion — runs without thinking
L2_autonomic.gaia: cron jobs (17 scheduled), DNS resolution, CDN caching, git auto-pull

L3_hormonal.name: HORMONAL (medium, adaptive)
L3_hormonal.biology: hormones adjust body state over hours — cortisol, insulin, growth hormone
L3_hormonal.gaia: beacon signals (bounty board), enzyme dispatch, shadow clone activation

L4_learned.name: LEARNED (slower, but smarter)
L4_learned.biology: cerebellum — learned motor patterns. ride a bike without thinking.
L4_learned.gaia: ant trails (popular routes reinforce), plasmid memory (holes → new bounties)

L5_conscious.name: CONSCIOUS (slowest, most flexible)
L5_conscious.biology: prefrontal cortex — deliberate planning, novel problem solving
L5_conscious.gaia: Kevin (the sun) — human attention, creative direction, constitution
L5_conscious.autonomy: 0% auto, 100% creative — THIS is the steering wheel

the_car_analogy.chassis: the 16 primals (129MB compiled Rust) = the car body
the_car_analogy.engine: barraCuda (ATP synthase) = the engine (converts energy → power)
the_car_analogy.transmission: songBird (mesh transport) = the transmission (routes power to wheels)
the_car_analogy.steering: biomeOS (ribosome) = the steering computer (reads instructions, steers)
the_car_analogy.brakes: skunkBat (protease) = the brakes (cuts threats, stops bad traffic)
the_car_analogy.GPS: DNS + beacon + chemotaxis = the navigation system
the_car_analogy.fuel: bounties = fuel (the work that powers the engine)
the_car_analogy.driver: L1-L4 = autopilot. L5 = Kevin. the car drives itself 80% of the time.

gaia_says: 15 routes mapped (14 live). highways (WireGuard, Cloudflare), arterials (HTTP, DNS, MCP), local roads (UDS, localhost, filesystem), return routes (RSS, neutrino, Discord), freight (17 cron, git auto-pull, rsync). GPS = chemotaxis — follow the gradient. DNS = street signs. beacon = pheromone. ant trails = emergent routing. self-driving: 5 autonomy levels. L1 reflexes (100% auto) → L5 conscious (Kevin steers). the car drives itself 80% of the time. the constitution is the highway code.
